title: Chris Van Hollen to challenge Chuck Schumer to lead Senate Democrats
summary: The Maryland senator announced his bid a week after Democrats won back the Senate.
body:
Senator Chris Van Hollen of Maryland announced on Thursday 12 November that he will challenge Chuck Schumer for the leadership of the Democrats in the US Senate.

The winner would become Senate majority leader in the next Congress, after the Democrats regained control of the chamber in this month's midterm elections.

What each side says

Van Hollen described himself as the underdog and said the race was "very much in flux". He has been publicly backed by Senator Bernie Sanders and by Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed.

Schumer, who is 75 and has led the party in the Senate since 2017, responded on social media: "I have the votes to continue serving as Democratic Leader."

Sources: CNN, CBS News, NPR.
